description: Since the 2026-10-30 docs, the value of every zone setting is typed as `string or number or boolean or 2 more` (generated as `unknown`) in listSettings, getSetting, patchSetting and bulk edit (request and result). Cloudflare gave zones_base.value an anyOf of all value kinds, and its docs build shows that base type in place of each setting's own value type. Cloudflare's OpenAPI (cloudflare/api-schemas) still types each setting's value (for example zones_0rtt.value is zones_0rtt_value, enum on/off), and no zones_*_value schema changed since 2026-10-28. The value shapes are restored from the docs as mirrored on 2026-10-29 (spec-mirror-cloudflare ff4dc733).
